contract.fake_only: BCT_FAKE_BAR_FILE and checked explicit BCM accessor required. KERNEL+fake rejected. Default/KERNEL every entry returns BCT_GATED and performs zero MMIO/callback I/O.
contract.link_down: Every entry and every endpoint read/write checks fake port RUN and LINKSTS UP with BUSY/L2 clear. Every step refuses with zero new writes on down link. Mid-send loss preserves applied H2D word, sends no later doorbell and latches fault.
contract.mailbox_scope: Bounded idle check, masked interrupts, preserved D2H word, one opaque synthetic H2D word. No operational firmware message/IRQ enable, ring allocation, bus mastering or DMA.
contract.memory: Aligned subtraction-based bounds; shared52B prefix, tail4B, H2D/D2H4B and ring-info20B prefix must fit RAM and not overlap. Ring-info contents/rings are not initialized.
contract.firmware_gate: Fake BAR is preseeded. No firmware bytes acquired/uploaded, embedded CPU reset/start or actual firmware readiness claim. Zero/unchanged tail WAIT is a real refusal.
contract.ownership: Caller-stable single-threaded context; genuine checked accessor required by C contract. Dirty before writes; I/O/verify/partial-transaction errors sticky; no retry/rollback/reinit escape. Metadata coherence/actual ownership remain unimplemented.
contract.other_controls: No GPIO152, SMC13, shared APCIE PHY/PMGR path. Shared fake escape macro refused; existing gated code and current packets untouched.
